method: 600px contact sheets for all 252; 1568px views of every selected frame and every posted frame in the album (about 160); 100% subject crops on 14. Instagram: 13 Seoul posts fingerprinted against the album (distance <= 7 reliable, 8-12 probable).

People of the palace (DU6F1a4AnN-): 8 more slides not in this album

frames.technical: power lines cross the right third of the sky
frames.critique: Opens Achasan today. Good view to Lotte Tower in clean afternoon light, but the lines are the first thing you see at full size and the light is still flat. A weak opener for the page's strongest chapter.

frames.technical: golf driving-range netting in the middle of the frame
frames.critique: Big flat blue sky, dark foreground, the net structure dead centre. Adds nothing 2299 doesn't.
My favourite of yours: the crowning tree on the ridge, raking gold light, the bent pine at left. Would open the page well.
Posted. The granite trail leading through pines to the city; layered and warm. Strong.
Square, haze-gold city with Namsan and glints on the windows. The best wide frame of the day.

frames.focus: slightly soft at 100% on the bird (long lens, low light); fine at display size
frames.critique: Posted cover. The magpie echoing Lotte Tower is a found joke and a real composition.
Lotte Tower in warm light. Holds its 5.
N Seoul Tower against orange. Holds its 5.
Closes Achasan. The couple on the rock looking at the city is a good closing idea, but they are soft and the dusk light is flat.
Posted. The tandem in golden light with Namsan behind; the crossing stripes lead in. A strong opener.
Posted, not selected. Sun over the marina, backlit grass in front. Stronger than 2071 or 2283 as a golden-hour frame.
Posted. Bollards and Namsan; graphic but empty.
Posted. Trees framing the sun between the towers, a photographer small at the bottom.
Posted. Two parked bikes at dusk; the empty upper half is a lot of plain sky.
Posted. Zinnias in front of the arch bridge; the flowers are darker than the sky.
Posted. Plain riverbank under the bridge; the weakest of the set.
Your quiet favourite: the willow island at deep twilight with the boat at right. It earns the 4 at full size.
In the selection. The zinnia field, but the blue construction hoarding and tarp-covered structures fill the middle; the flowers are the only clean layer.
Posted (the 'mom' post cover), not selected. Same field at pink dusk with Inwangsan at right and people walking in; the clearly better frame.
Posted. The ringed building over the zinnias at blue hour. Strong architecture-plus-flowers frame.
Kochia rows leading to a plain school block. Graphic foreground, dull destination.
Posted. Pines and lamps over a lane at blue hour, people walking in. Atmospheric.
Posted. The ringed facade and the stepped lawn; graphic.
Posted, not selected. Near-twin of 2244 (selected): same lane, the couple a little closer. Swap, don't add.
Lit hanok corner with passers-by; lively, a little busy.
Posted cover. The fairy-light eaves.
Posted, not selected. A curving alley at night with string lights and a red ivy wall; strong.
SOOC. The floating Starbucks pavilion, swan boats, a cyclist in stripes. Lively but the brand signage is a lot of the frame.
SOOC. Fisherman on the rocks in warm light, Lotte Tower across the water, the footbridge as a diagonal. One of the best Han frames.
Backlit pampas and the sun at the end of the path; the SLOW sign and the lamp post sit dead centre and clutter it.
Posted cover; your override stands. The wisteria arbour frames it well; the low fence in front is busy.
Deoksugung hall through leaves; flat white sky and a lot of lawn. The weakest palace frame.
Painted eaves receding in a diagonal; graphic and saturated without being pushed.
Posted, not selected. Junghwajeon framed by an old pine, a couple sitting on the steps. Stronger than 2164 on every count.
Posted. The small girl against the hanok lattice is the right scale; the red extinguisher pulls the eye. Crop it or clone it (edit queue).

frames.focus: soft at 100%: grain and slight motion
frames.critique: The hanbok hug under a pink sky; the moment carries it. A blemish, not a drop.
Heungnyemun at dusk with the crowds; a clear establishing frame, busy.

frames.technical: the red barrier crosses the lower third
frames.critique: The arch framing Heungnyemun and Bugaksan at pink dusk. Holds its 5; the barrier echoes the red, so it reads as a layer, not a flaw.
Kids in the fountain under the scaled Starbucks facade. Fun (your 'Paid by big coffee' post), but the brand is the subject; a poor chapter opener.
Arched fountain jets and a laughing child; good energy, the camera is a blemish.
Posted cover. Stepping stones leading to the wall under pink cloud.
Gwanghwamun head-on with the stepping stones; the clearest 'where we are' frame of the chapter.
Posted. The empty wall, three bands: sky, wall, grass. Minimal on purpose.
Posted. The wall with two pairs walking; the best of the minimal frames.
Posted. Walkers at both edges; 2195 balances it better.
The lit wall and gate tower at blue hour, people strolling. A strong closer.
In the selection. The walled lane at night, a couple under the far lamp. Near-twin of 2245.
